title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
statement: Given an unsorted integer array, return the length of the longest sequence of consecutive values. The sequence does not have to be contiguous in the array.
hints: Sorting yields an O(n log n) answer by scanning neighbors.
A set supports O(1) membership. Only start a run at a value whose predecessor is absent.
Each number is visited at most twice: once in the outer loop and once inside a single run.

approaches.name: Hash set runs
approaches.explanation: Start counting only at the beginning of a streak.

editorial: Put every value in a set. A value starts a consecutive run only when value - 1 is missing. From each start, walk upward while value + 1 exists and track the longest walk. Numbers in the middle of a run are skipped as starts, so the total walk cost stays linear.
reference_solution:
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict, deque
import heapq

def longest_consecutive(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    pool = set(nums)
    best = 0
    for value in pool:
        if value - 1 in pool:
            continue
        length = 1
        while value + length in pool:
            length += 1
        best = max(best, length)
    return best
